title: Cow wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8b6f5e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='78' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8b6f5e'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='86' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d5c0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='86' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d5c0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='86' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d5c0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='86' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d5c0'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='29' y='93' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>
  <rect x='43' y='93' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>
  <rect x='55' y='93' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>
  <rect x='67' y='93' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5c4033'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- Head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8b6f5e'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='40' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f5e6d3' transform='rotate(-20 28 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='40' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f5e6d3' transform='rotate(20 72 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='40' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#e8a0a0' transform='rotate(-20 28 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='40' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#e8a0a0' transform='rotate(20 72 40)'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='3' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='3' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='45' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#e8a0a0'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#c07070'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#c07070'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 59 Q50 62 54 59' stroke='#c07070' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,20 36,40 64,40' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='46,28 44,34 56,34 54,28' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <polygon points='42,36 40,40 60,40 58,36' fill='#6bcbff'/>
  <!-- Hat pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='19' r='4' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Hat trim -->
  <rect x='35' y='38' width='30' height='3' rx='1' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M78 72 Q86 68 84 60' stroke='#f5e6d3' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='58' r='3' fill='#8b6f5e'/>
</svg>
